messages:
alex_ops: Noticed a surge in tiny-gang pending in ap-southeast1-b. Lots of single-gpu pods landing on separate racks, high fragmentation.
priya_sre: Yup saw that. Node-level GPU utilization is low but pod spread across racks. Eviction spikes up 3x for tiny workloads.
rory_sched: Any recent perf-change to the affinity scoring or the rack local tiebreaker?
emma_infra: We rolled a scheduler tweak yesterday to prioritize AZ balance for lower P95 inter-AZ latency. Might be over-emphasizing spread for tiny gangs.
alex_ops: Example log:
```
SCORE pod=hf-train-mini score=5 (binpack:-2, az_balance:12, rack_local:3, anti_affinity:0)
```
lena-pm: Cost note: extra evictions and restarts add up—seen ~8% more GPU-hours billed on that cluster week-over-week.
priya_sre: Hypothesis: for pods with label gpu.size=tiny we should favor binpack more aggressively, but keep AZ balance for larger gangs.
rory_sched: I can push a conditional rule: if pod.gang_size <=2 AND pod.label("gpu.size")=="tiny" then reduce az_balance weight by 6 and increase binpack by 8 for scheduling decisions.
emma_infra: Tempting, but watch thermal/reliability. Packing increases hotspot risk on older hosts. Need node temp and power telemetry attached to canary.
alex_ops: ops-bot, can you run quick health probes (gpu_temp, node_power, evictions) in ap-southeast1-b and report top 5 affected nodes?
ops-bot: probe started by alex_ops. Tasks: list_hot_nodes, evict_rate_last_15m, az_link_latency. ETA 90s.
ops-bot: probe results: top nodes: gnode-azb-102 (evict_rate 0.12), gnode-azb-117 (0.09), gnode-azb-201 (0.07). avg_gpu_temp normal. link_latency within expected. Full CSV link: https://internal/reports/6543210987
priya_sre: temps look ok. I'll start a 15-minute scheduler canary in ap-southeast1-b only: alter weights for label gpu.size=tiny as rory suggested. Auto-rollback if any node exceeds 92% GPU util for 45s or evictions increase.
rory_sched: Canary manifest:
```
selector: pod.label("gpu.size") == "tiny"
set_weights:
  az_balance: 6 -> 0
  binpack: -2 -> 6
  rack_local: 3 -> 4
window: 15m
```
emma_infra: ops-bot will also attach telemetry tag "sched-canary:2026-03-21-apb" to those pods so we can query easily.
ops-bot: canary applied at 6543211000 to ap-southeast1-b. Monitoring metrics: eviction_rate, gpu_util, gpu_temp, pod_restart_count.
alex_ops: Initial 5m check: evictions down ~55% for tiny pods, binpack improved (avg pods/node +1.8). No temp or power anomalies.
lena-pm: Good. Capture short cost delta for 1h projection and include restart savings.
priya_sre: Canary will run full 15m, then if stable we'll cascade to ap-southeast1-a for 10m and then to ap-southeast1-c. Rolling updates spaced 7m.
rory_sched: Added auto-fallback: if per-node GPU util > 92% for 45s OR gpu_temp > 82C OR evict_rate rises, revert weights immediately.
emma_infra: Follow-up ticket created: ENG-PLAT-8721 (evaluate default affinity thresholds for tiny vs small vs large gangs). Assigning to rory_sched and emma_infra.
alex_ops: Thanks all. After the rollout we'll consider shrinking pinned-pool for tiny workloads and rely on consolidated warm nodes with appropriate resiliency.
ops-bot: canary status at 6543211187: PASS (evictions -58%, avg_gpu_temp stable, node_power steady). Canary window closed, proceeding with staged rollout per plan unless objected.
